item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Yellow Days + Rue Jacobs @ The Bellwether 2026-02-27
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.



This was a weird one. He was ascendant when I first saw him at Moroccan Lounge with gradually bigger places each time. Now he's adopted a northern soul sound and seemed to draw a Moroccan Lounge size crowd in his othewise biggest venue yet.

The day before I went to get my 2nd dose of the shingles vaccine. They said you need Flu and Covid booster. I said "will this ruin my weekend?" Nope you'll be find. Never had issues with vaccines before so I took them all.

The night before on the way home I feel a little off, then start to get the chills. Get off the bus and get hit so hard with shivers so intense my body tenses up like I have rigor mortis and can barely walk the rest of the way home. This show I just wanted to go back to the venue, enjoy the lovely view of downtown from the patio while I smoke a joint. In spite of the lingering effects, I still do just that. And for Yellow Days I was able to find a seat and go right to sleep for most of the whole set.

Enjoy!
